reason: security.secret_detected: The artifact contains one or more detected secrets (github_pat, aws_access_key). Admission is blocked until secrets are removed and rotated.

remediation_options.description: Remove the detected secret from the artifact, rotate the secret in your secrets manager, and resubmit the artifact for admission.
Workspace owner may review the artifact and request a scoped override if the detection is a false positive.
Tenant administrator may issue a time-bounded override for this gate type within the workspace scope after audited review.
